body.statement: Let two legal replacements of one source-isolated terminal agree on every complete single-world primitive-equation event indexed by every boundary assignment in the supplied menu. Holding exterior mechanisms and sources fixed makes the global models agree on every coordinate of \(p\); if the certificate carries a transmitting boundary assignment with nonzero target cross-product, their global conditional targets differ.
body.justification: A local separator proves completeness only if agreement and target separation survive recursive attachment.
body.gap: LeeCorreaBareinboim2020 glues acyclic witnesses, and RichardsonEvansRobinsShpitser2023 composes acyclic fixing kernels; neither preserves cyclic legality and granular source incidence through this interface.
body.consumer: The checker can validate a local negative terminal and downstream transmission independently of the search.
